output.reason: The linked PR [ev-cf2549afcb83] says what the one-line changelog entry [ev-57c05cdbb7d0] leaves out. The Traefik internal provider could panic when SPIFFE is enabled but no default servers transport with a SPIFFE config is given. The PR fixes that panic, and the change touches only pkg/provider/traefik/internal.go [ev-0c0c122689c9]. That gives a concrete exposure condition (SPIFFE enabled, no SPIFFE config on the default servers transport) and a concrete consequence (before the fix, a possible panic in the internal provider; this release removes it), enough to write the applicability and consequence aspects.
